slug: 2024-05-17 Validation of The Gambia's National Digital ID and Digital Transformation Strategy

facts.fact: UNECA reports a two-day validation workshop on 16-17 May 2024 for the National Digital ID and Digital Transformation Strategy 2023-2028; the workshop 'refined and validated' its action plans, and no adoption by an act or body is stated.
facts.system: National Digital ID and Digital Transformation Strategy 2023-2028

facts.fact: The strategy is titled 2023-2028, so it is inside its period as at the validation workshop of May 2024. Text public: not stated.
facts.system: National Digital ID and Digital Transformation Strategy 2023-2028

facts.fact: The 16-17 May 2024 workshop refined and validated action plans for both the Digital ID and Digital Transformation strategies; no cost or dated targets are stated.
facts.system: National Digital ID and Digital Transformation Strategy 2023-2028

facts.fact: The initiative was launched by the Government in December 2022 through the Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy, with technical and financial support from UNECA; no domestic budget line is stated.
